ORDER UNDER SECTION 2 (1) OF THE LAND GRANT

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms do hereby rescind and declare the Schedulebelow, in terms of the power under Section 18 of the Interpretation Ordinance, as it is observed that an administrativeerror has been occurred by the Gazette Notification mentioned below due to the decision to grant the persons calledArjun Indrajith Gunarathne and Amitha Lal Gunarathne, two children of the deponent of the file Co/ 1362 as a release ofa primary legal obligation of the Land Reform Commission and handing them over the possession of the allotment ofland described in the Schedule below, declared by the publishing date of the Gazette Notification No. 180/ 5 dated17.02.1982 under the aforesaid Act and the Section, by Mr. Lionel Gamini Dissanayake, precedent Minister of Land andLand Development by virtue of powers vested under Section 2 (1) of the Land Grant (Special Provisions) Act, No. 43 of1979.
GAYANTHA KARUNATILLEKE,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
